corpus.segmentation: One row per simplified sentence. An original sentence therefore spans several rows (3.6 on average, up to 16), and a single sentence is sometimes split across two consecutive rows.
corpus.note: The three language corpora are NOT parallel. Criterion codes must never be compared across languages.
